rows.07:249d0:
I went into the classroom.
Rows of desks and chairs, neatly lined up.
Seeing it like this, it was hard to believe students used it during the day.
The classroom felt colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I had to search.
First, I checked the teacher's lectern.
...Nothing.
Next, I checked the desks.
Of course, I searched thoroughly inside them too.
...Nothing.
I searched every corner of the room.
It didn't look like it was in this classroom.{p}
rows.07:24b58:
I went into the classroom.
Rows of desks and chairs, neatly lined up.
Seeing it like this, it was hard to believe students used it during the day.
The classroom felt colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I had to search.
First, I checked the teacher's lectern.
There seemed to be something inside it.
What could it be?
I shoved my hand in.
Ow☆
I yanked it back out.
When I looked closely, I saw the inside of the lectern was thickly studded with thumbtacks.
Was this the work of Hino and the others?
Had they known I would shove my hand in here?
...No, that couldn't be.
It was just a coincidence.
It had to be.
There didn't seem to be anything else in this classroom.{p}
rows.07:25c6c:
I decided to search the toilet stall.
I opened the door.{p}
rows.07:2692c:
Not that there was much to it; there were just eight or so big desks in rows.
I was finished with them almost at once.
Looks like that was a waste of time.{p}Now, what should I do?
rows.07:26c90:
"I'll kill you!"
Iwashita lunged at me, her hair flying wildly.
She was clutching a rope in her hands.
Was that the rope that had bound my hands and feet?
I had no time to get my footing back.
As I fell, the rope looped around my neck.
"Die!"
Then Iwashita pulled with all her strength.
"Gaaack!"
In one jerk, the rope cinched tight around my throat.
I tried to tear Iwashita's arms away.
But they wouldn't budge.
I couldn't believe a girl could be that strong.
Little by little, my strength drained away.
I could feel the blood vessels in my head pounding violently: thump, thump.
In a place like this... am I going to die?
I...
The rope strangled me without mercy.
Everything before my eyes was turning red.
I collapsed to the floor.
...Faintly, through the red darkness, I could see Iwashita's triumphant smile.{p}
rows.07:26fac:
...There was a notebook.
On it were written the words "Grudge Notebook."{p}Should I read it?
rows.07:270ac:
I opened the notebook.
Inside were petty gripes written by Hino, Shindo and the others.
Spilled coffee on me.
Got barked at by a dog.
Hid my shoes.
Told a stupid joke.
Tapped me on the shoulder out of nowhere.
Was noisy when I was sleepy.
Has a vulgar laugh.
Never apologized.
Paid back the money I lent them without any interest.
Wouldn't let me copy their notes.
...Along with that petty nonsense, many people's names were written down.{p}
rows.07:272c0:
Yo, {a}.
I figured you'd come back to the newspaper club, so I'm leaving this notebook on the shelf for you.
If you find it, read it carefully.
These are the sinners we've killed so far.
There are plenty of reasons you're going to be killed.
You've committed crimes that would justify the death penalty.
The charges are as follows.{p}
